author: claude-opus-5-5
comparison: Rejected drawing split the belt into two closed boxes with no buckle and hung small squares on stubs, reading as a sign on posts; the original is one strap through a raised buckle with two weight blocks hanging below.
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px light/dark. Continuous strap with a proud rounded buckle at the centre and two weight blocks hanging on straps; reads as a weight belt at 48.
omissions: Buckle tongue slots (no 8-unit room in the 14-high buckle); the buckle stands proud above the strap only, and the weights hang near the belt ends so their hangers keep 8 from the buckle.
